hero_title: Authentic Sri Lanka, Tailored For You
hero_subtitle: Experience the vibrant culture, untamed wildlife, mist-shrouded tea mountains, and pristine tropical beaches of our island home — planned by local experts.
welcome_body: We are a passionate team of local Sri Lankan travel designers dedicated to showcasing the authentic magic of our island. Whether you seek a short day trip to ancient UNESCO temples or an immersive two-week island loop, we curate genuine, responsible journeys tailored specifically for your pace and budget.
about_story: Born from a deep love for our island home, Serendib Days was created to offer a better way to experience Sri Lanka. We are not a faceless global aggregator; we are locals who know the hidden trails, the best time to spot leopards, and where to taste the most authentic village curries.
